notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[u]Bug Fixes:[/u]
- Sparker Secondary no damage to Portal Generators.
- Destroy Mission conflicts on death after all objectives completed.
- Crusher gets burned of using Main Ammo on Flamethrowers.
- VIP Markers on Map off position after picking them up.
- Terrain Edges wrong thickness fixed.
- Alien Shield + Invincible Cloak could cause negative damage under specific conditions.
- Sparker's Damage Amplifier effect collision with lasers.
- Damaging Shield on Cannon Walker bug.
- Damaging Shield slowing down enemies.
- Extra Special Ammo disables Pre-Charged Special.
- Mechanicus not repairing when infinitesimal health left.
- Reflective Shield resets Enemies flying path.
- SFX missing on Square Obstacles.

notes.title: Version 020 Patch Notes
notes.content:
This will probably be the last version we upload before we launch Gravitators.

We're almost finished, just final bugs to solve and final details to polish. The end is near!

[u]Bugs fixed:[/u]

[list]
[*] Crusher with Main Ammo Upgrade transparency bug.
[*] Keymapping bugs.
[*] Fixed some ending animations.
[*] Added Memorial Wall, with the list of fallen pilots.
[*] Added Steam Rich Presence, to see in-game location of Steam friends.
[*] Added Performance Tab in Debriefing, to see performance .
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.1.5 patch notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

With the launch date closing in, I'll be posting the fixes and implementations for each game update. The pre-launch fixes apply to both the demo and the beta build (to whoever has access to it).


[u]Here are the patch notes of version 0.1.5:[/u]

- Implemented Modern Controls (WASD + mouse or Left + Right Analogs).
- Gamepads/controllers full support.
- Beautified all Destroy Enemies missions backgrounds.
- Implemented final Achievement Section.
- Added visual feedback for trap doors.
- Bug fixing: Power Ups, Map Icons, Enemies, Tutorial Texts, Map Controller sensitivity with controllers, Return from map released carried item with controllers.

- Beautified all Destroy Enemies missions backgrounds.
- Added visual feedback for trap doors.
